verdict.rationale: A state business-filing authority could plausibly document registered agents, authorized filers, or other designees, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing bot walls on www.nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov, and none of them is about a sanctioned third-party rail. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
